QB model components — producers, not acceptance gates.
coaching signal producers with their own gate tests (intelligence/tests/test_coaching_gates.py, a separate suite); their claims are policed by signal.claim_matrix in this run.
forecast-combination library (AFCRPS etc.) — machinery, not an acceptance gate over the run.
regime/drift research modules with their own tests; not wired as run-path gates in this branch.
tipster/social trust scoring — a different domain (source trust), not a gate over engine output for a game.
reasoning trace machinery (adversary/checklist/escalation); the arbitration surface that IS a gate — mint_gate — is wired.

engines/llm is an LLM specialist harness; engines/drift_monitor.py is a HuggingFace ZeroGPU free-tier cost tripwire (cron infra that makes live network calls) — neither is an acceptance gate over a priced game run.

the FeatureStore / latest_prior_row point-in-time machinery is wired where a feature store exists; this run path consumes frozen captures, not a feature store. leakwall's market-feed rule (select_market_snapshot) IS wired at INGEST.
research convergence sweep; its honest result (15 of 27 cases diverge) is a finding, not a run-path gate. The cylindrical solver itself is a model component, not a gate.
TypeScript app (Keel UI) inside intelligence/ — not a Python gate.
Windows voice daemon lane (Hermes). Its watchdog's announcement gating is fixed in the PR #1156 hygiene lane, not here.
specialist integration plumbing (api/providers/synthesis) — machinery, not acceptance gates.
